# `state_comments`

Public comments on state regulatory actions, with full text, one row per comment. Virginia only so far, from the Virginia Regulatory Town Hall, whose Public Comment Policy makes comments public records. Comments are posted to a forum: a stage's comment period (`forum_type = 'stage'`), a general notice, or a petition for rulemaking. Sorted by `jurisdiction`, `forum_type`, then `forum_id` descending, so `WHERE stage_id = ?` and `WHERE forum_id = ?` prune row groups. Built by `build_va_townhall`.

- **Parquet file:** `state_comments.parquet`
- **Queryable via MCP `query_sql`:** Yes

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `jurisdiction` | `VARCHAR` | USPS code of the state (`VA`). |
| `comment_id` | `BIGINT` | Town Hall comment ID. Unique within `jurisdiction`. |
| `forum_type` | `VARCHAR` | `stage` (a stage's comment period), `general_notice` or `petition`. |
| `forum_id` | `BIGINT` | ID of the stage, general notice or petition the comment was posted to. |
| `stage_id` | `BIGINT` | Stage the comment is on (joins `state_stages.stage_id`); NULL for general-notice and petition forums. |
| `commenter` | `VARCHAR` | Commenter's name: the part of `commenter_raw` before the first comma, keeping name suffixes and credentials such as `Jr.` or `PhD`. Often `Anonymous`, and sometimes an organization name. |
| `organization` | `VARCHAR` | Organization, from the part of `commenter_raw` after the first comma. Town Hall prints name and organization in one field, so this split is a best effort: a commenter who typed a comma in their name, or a role such as `parent`, lands here too. NULL when there was no comma. |
| `commenter_raw` | `VARCHAR` | Commenter field exactly as Town Hall prints it (`Name, Organization`). |
| `title` | `VARCHAR` | Title the commenter gave the comment. |
| `comment` | `VARCHAR` | Comment text, converted from the posted HTML to plain text with a blank line between paragraphs. NULL for a comment posted with a title and no body. |
| `posted_date` | `VARCHAR` | Date the comment was posted (YYYY-MM-DD). |
| `posted_at` | `VARCHAR` | Date and time the comment was posted, in Virginia local time with no zone (`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM`). |
| `url` | `VARCHAR` | Town Hall page for the comment. |
| `fetched_at` | `VARCHAR` | UTC time this row was last fetched (ISO 8601). |
